summary: Visit Shopping Mall in My Tizi Town! Explore different stores in shopping games.
description:
Play the shopping game. Tizi Mall is the place to spend your time shopping and having a great time!

Check out Tizi Mall, the biggest and most beautiful mall in town. Visit the shopping mall and spend your whole day shopping! Our shopping game is fun and will keep you engaged for hours.

Want to get a new hairstyle? Head to the salon and get some much-needed pampering. Want to withdraw cash? Don't worry, Tizi Mall has multiple ATMs so you can shop and have a great time with complete peace of mind.

Check out the awesome new gadgets in the electronic shop. Buy the latest mobile phones, tablets, and headphones at attractive prices! Don't forget to check out the awesome toy store next door. You can shop for everything from teddy bears to remote-controlled helicopters. And while you're at it, also check out special toys for babies and toddlers.

Head to the clothes section on the 2nd floor of the Tizi shopping mall and check out the new stylish collection for boys and girls. Shop for jeans, t-shirts, footwear, and accessories. Do you love sports? Then you surely don't want to miss out on the shorts section. Check out the amazing gear and accessories like tennis rackets, basketballs, backpacks, water bottles, kettlebells, and more. And lastly, buy yourself some stylish sunglasses and fancy hats from the shop next door.

Are you starving after shopping all day? Head to the rooftop cafeteria and feast on some delicious burgers, sandwiches, fries, and milkshakes. Then, enjoy some mouth-watering desserts like cakes, donuts, and pastries from the vending machine. And finally, enjoy some exciting arcade games with your friends while listening to the live band. 

Tizi Mall is the place to spend your weekends with friends and family. Experience the joy of shopping with the shopping mall game.
 
Here's what makes our mall game an absolute blast to play:
- Vibrant and colorful graphics make playing so much fun
- 3 floors complete with rooftop cafeteria, arcade section, and live band
- 100% safe for kids and features age-appropriate content
- Dress characters in different costumes and accessories
- You can touch, move, and interact with all the objects in the game

Experience the pleasure of shopping and hanging out with friends with the most amazing shopping game in town. Download My Tizi Town: Shopping Mall Games and start shopping right away!
